newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Quiet market sees Lithuanian shares dip.
newsitem.headline: Quiet market sees Lithuanian shares dip.

text.p: Most shares slid in subdued trading at Lithuania's stock exchange by the close on Monday although banks showed signs of life.
The official list index dropped 9.09 points to 897.68 points while the broader group A index declined 4.23 points to 1876.76.
Central market turnover was 405,386 litas while the block market saw 1.7 million litas of trade.
"Today's central market activities show that brokers have an interest in certain shares but are not interested in pushing up prices right now," said one broker.
Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank, which spearheaded last week's mild recovery, remained popular on the central market and in block trades, although they made no progress in prices.
Vilniaus Bank turned over about 1.2 million litas in block trades at 230 litas and held steady on the central market at 230 litas, with turnover there of 62,560 litas.
"There's no reason to push it any higher," said one broker. "At 230 litas, there are plenty of shares in supply."
Rival Hermis Bank declined to 190 litas from 195 litas on central market turnover of 116,850 litas. Hermis saw 95,000 litas turnover in block trades at 190 litas.
